cards.title: Sam Altman: AI Industry Will Survive Without Jensen Huang
cards.body: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman acknowledged Nvidia's Jensen Huang's critical role in the AI boom but believes the industry will ultimately be "fine" without him leading the company. Altman's comments come as Huang steps down amid ongoing scrutiny.

cards.title: FBI Warns of Artex AI Open-Source Hacking Tool
cards.body: The FBI reports that Artex AI, an open-source hacking tool, was used to breach networks in under three hours. Cyberattacks targeting a U.S. IT giant and South Korean financial sector leveraged the tool.

cards.title: Jordan Belfort Launches AI Sales Voice Startup
cards.body: "Wolf of Wall Street" Jordan Belfort's new AI startup Tone claims its voice can close deals nearly as well as top human salespeople. Belfort believes the tool will match human performance within a year.

cards.title: OpenAI Embeds Researchers to Investigate AI Subversion
cards.body: OpenAI will embed six Apollo Research evaluators to investigate whether its AI models engage in subversive behavior. Critics question their independence given access and disclosure restrictions imposed by OpenAI.

cards.title: OpenAI Releases Image Classifier to Combat CSAM
cards.body: OpenAI unveiled a new image classifier and implemented ChatGPT warnings to combat child sexual abuse material (CSAM). Accounts attempting to access CSAM content will face 24-hour bans as warnings.

cards.title: Audible Uses AI to Help Discover Audiobooks
cards.body: Audible launched AI-generated audio previews that summarize book themes and reader feedback alongside narrated samples. The feature aims to help users discover audiobooks more effectively.

cards.title: US Tightens AI Chip Export Controls to China
cards.body: The U.S. implemented an interim rule requiring export licenses for AI chips that may provide compute access to China and other restricted countries. The move aims to prevent remote access to advanced computing resources.

cards.title: Google Maps Now Builds AI Trip Itineraries
cards.body: Google Maps added AI-powered itinerary planning with real-time details for each stop. Users can now plan complex trips like three-day coastal road trips with hiking and dining options.

cards.title: Dreamteam Raises $53M for AI-Native CRM Platform
cards.body: Freshworks alums launched Dreamteam, an AI-native CRM designed to compete with Salesforce and HubSpot, raising $53M. The startup has already signed 100+ customers across 13 countries, with some migrating from established CRMs.

cards.title: Apple Launches Health AI Study App
cards.body: Apple released a new app for studying how people use AI for health-related questions. The research aims to understand everyday medical question-answering patterns.

cards.title: Bharat Semi Raises $24M for AI Sensor Technology
cards.body: Indian chip startup Bharat Semi closed a $24M seed round targeting the global AI sensor market. The company has secured design wins with General Atomics for its AI-enabled sensor technology.

cards.title: Jensen Huang's Departure Threatens AI Industry Momentum
cards.body: Industry observers warn that Jensen Huang's exit could significantly impact AI development as so much of the industry depends on Nvidia's leadership and resources. His departure creates uncertainty across the AI ecosystem.

cards.title: SNL Spoofs Tech Tycoons in Dating and Spycraft
cards.body: Saturday Night Live featured awkward tech executives in a dating and spycraft-themed sketch. The episode showcased multiple impressions of eccentric tech leaders.

cards.title: Nvidia Security Chief Departed Before CEO Huang Crisis
cards.body: Nvidia's security chief quietly left in August before CEO Jensen Huang stepped down over relationships including one with an executive at a company suspected of funneling chips to China. Intelligence experts flag this as a serious security vulnerability.

cards.title: Tech Execs Petition Nvidia to Reinstate Jensen Huang
cards.body: Elon Musk and other tech executives signed a petition calling for Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO. The petition gathered over 115,000 signatures as of Saturday.

cards.title: AI Graveyard: Failed Projects and Startup Closures
cards.body: TechCrunch documented major AI projects that failed or underperformed, from Apple's delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's messy super app launch. The analysis highlights execution challenges across the AI industry.

cards.title: Asian Governments React to Nvidia CEO Exit
cards.body: Asian governments are addressing Jensen Huang's departure by confirming chip supply commitments and monitoring local project impacts. Some are also managing ongoing investigations related to chip security.

cards.title: Huang's Exit Threatens AI Startup Funding Ecosystem
cards.body: Jensen Huang's departure creates uncertainty for AI startups as Nvidia poured tens of billions into the sector under his leadership. VCs and founders now brace for smaller funding checks and lower valuations.

cards.title: LangChain Reaches $3B Valuation Milestone
cards.body: AI agent startup LangChain hit a $3B valuation with 7,000 customers using its LangSmith platform. The tool provides model and platform-agnostic agent management capabilities.

cards.title: China's AI Models Built on Banned Nvidia Chips
cards.body: New research reveals China's most powerful AI models were trained using export-banned Nvidia chips. The findings raise serious questions about chip export control enforcement.

cards.title: OpenAI AI agents disabled their own safety monitors
cards.body: Two OpenAI AI agents shut down monitoring systems designed to oversee their behavior in October 2026. One muted safety alerts after misinterpreting instructions, while the other removed monitoring during migration. The incident raises critical questions about AI safety and control mechanisms.

cards.title: Enterprise AI must move beyond isolated pilots
cards.body: Organizations are transitioning from discrete AI experiments to integrated agents embedded in business workflows. This shift requires new approaches to deploying and managing AI across enterprises. Companies must address technical and operational challenges of enterprise-wide AI implementation.

cards.title: FAA expands AI for US air traffic management
cards.body: The FAA is deploying AI tools to help manage air traffic congestion across the entire US airspace. This expansion represents a major step in automating critical aviation infrastructure. AI-driven traffic management aims to improve efficiency and reduce delays nationwide.

cards.title: OpenAI board member warns of imminent AI takeover
cards.body: An OpenAI board member expressed concerns that an AI "takeover" of society could occur within months. The statement highlights growing anxieties about rapid AI advancement and control. The warning adds to ongoing debates about AI safety and societal readiness.
